notes: REF-BM-02: server fetches title/description/favicon but never a preview image (no og:image). REF-BM-04: editable url/title/description/tags but no note field exists in the data model. REF-BM-06: add always creates a new UUID bookmark; no duplicate-url detection or convergence to editing. REF-BM-10: tag entry is a plain comma-separated text input with no autocomplete of existing tags. REF-BM-12: search covers title/description/url/tags but there is no note field to search. REF-BM-14: query is a plain substring match; no #tag syntax (tags stored without #). REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised group parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-20: no multi-select/bulk actions. REF-BM-21: no bulk action over the filtered collection. REF-BM-23: no markdown note feature. REF-BM-24: no local HTML snapshot or PDF handling. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive concept (only favorite/read); nothing distinguishes archive from delete and no archived-only view. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: sort and grid/list toggles exist as transient UI state but there is no persisted personal-settings feature (no default sort, displayed items, or font size setting).
